# Context

This script provides select code to identify any emergency department (ED) visit among dual-eligible enrollees in each beneficiary-month observed during the study period.

We identified ED visits using guidance from [ResDAC](https://resdac.org/articles/how-identify-hospital-claims-emergency-room-visits-medicare-claims-data): claims containing emergency room charges are found in the Inpatient and Outpatient claims files, identified by Revenue Center Code (REV_CNTR) values of 0450-0459 (emergency room) or 0981 (professional fees-emergency room). We searched for ED visits that resulted in an inpatient admission in the Medicare Inpatient Encounters and TAF Inpatient files; otherwise, we located ED visits in the Medicare Outpatient Encounters and TAF Other Services files.

This code assumes the user has already combined Medicare encounters (Inpatient and Outpatient) and TAF claims (Inpatient and Other Services files) into a single claim-line table called `claims`, with one row per claim line. The table should include the following variables:  

- bene_id  
- claim_id  
- from_dt (claim header begin date)    
- thru_dt (claim header end date)  
- line_from_dt (either the line date or revenue center from date)
- line_thru_dt (either the line date or revenue center thru date) 
- rev_cntr (revenue center code)  

This code also assumes the user has created an enrollee-month cohort table called `mbsf` (as described in `select_code_to_identify_same_insurer_status.Rmd`), onto which the final ED outcome is merged.



# Define ED revenue codes

```{r}
ed_codes <- c("0450", "0451", "0452", "0453", "0454", "0455", "0456", "0457", "0458", "0459", "0981")
```


# Flag and restrict to ED claims

```{r}
# flag any claim where at least one line carries an ED revenue code
claims[, ed := fcase(rev_cntr %in% ed_codes, 1, default = 0)] %>%
  .[, ed := max(ed), by = claim_id]

# keep only ED claims
claims <- claims[ed == 1]
```


# Fix ED visit dates

Claim header dates (from_dt/thru_dt) don't always reflect when the ED visit occurred. When a revenue line date is available, we replace the header date with it.

```{r}
# pull the ED revenue line dates onto all lines of the claim
claims[rev_cntr %in% ed_codes, `:=` (new_from_dt = rev_cntr_from_dt,
                                     new_thru_dt = rev_cntr_thru_dt)]
claims[, `:=` (new_from_dt = min(new_from_dt, na.rm = T),
               new_thru_dt = max(new_thru_dt, na.rm = T)), by = claim_id]

# replace header dates with revenue line dates when available
claims[, `:=` (from_dt = ifelse(!is.na(new_from_dt), new_from_dt, from_dt),
               thru_dt = ifelse(!is.na(new_thru_dt), new_thru_dt, thru_dt))]
```


# Roll claims up to one row per encounter

```{r}
ed_claims <- claims[, .(from_dt = min(from_dt), thru_dt = max(thru_dt)), by = .(bene_id, claim_id)]
```


# Collapse overlapping/contiguous claims into a single visit

A single ED visit can generate more than one claim (e.g. a facility claim and a professional claim, or a Medicare claim and a TAF claim for the same visit). We group claims for the same beneficiary that overlap or are contiguous and treat them as one visit.

```{r}
setorder(ed_claims, bene_id, from_dt)

# group overlapping/contiguous claims into a visit id
ed_claims[, visit_id := chse::overlapping(from_dt, thru_dt, maxgap = 0), by = bene_id]

# collapse each group into a single visit
ed_visits <- ed_claims[, .(ed_start = min(from_dt), ed_end = max(thru_dt)), by = .(bene_id, visit_id)]
```


# Create "any ED visit" flag by month

```{r}
ed_visits[, `:=` (calendar_mo = month(ed_start), year = year(ed_start))]

final <- unique(ed_visits[, .(bene_id, year, calendar_mo, ed = 1)])
```


# Merge outcome to cohort table

```{r}
mbsf <- merge(mbsf, final, by = c("bene_id", "year", "calendar_mo"), all.x = T)

# bene-months with no ED visit should be 0, not NA
setnafill(mbsf, fill = 0, cols = "ed")
```
